newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela opens marginal oil fields roadshow.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela opens marginal oil fields roadshow.

text.p: Venezuela showcased 20 marginal oil fields Friday in the opening of a roadshow for the auction of operating concessions that will move to Houston and then London later this month.

Production at the 20 marginal fields, due to be contracted out for 20 years as part of Venezuela's third round of marginal field auctions, is seen rising in ten years to at least 300,000 barrels per day (bpd) from current levels of 66,000 bpd, officials from state-owned Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) said.

Required total investment is seen at around $4.6 billion over ten years, PdVSA co-ordinator for exploration and production Juan Szabo said, "although the exact amount clearly depends on those companies that successfully bid for the concessions."
Nevertheless, "all operators will have to complete a minimum three year investment program as part of their contract," Szabo told reporters.
Five of the 20 concessions will be exclusively reserved for national operators, PdVSA has said.
